# diytracker.ch

> DIY, punk and underground concerts in Switzerland — shows, festivals and venues.

Hand-curated, non-commercial listings of DIY, punk, hardcore and underground
shows across Switzerland. Updated continuously. Available in German, French,
Italian and English (URLs are prefixed with /fr/, /it/, /en/; German is the
default, unprefixed locale).

## Browse

- [Calendar]({{ canonical_url(url_for('public.calendar_view', lang_prefix=None)) }}): upcoming shows, all cantons and genres.
- [About]({{ canonical_url(url_for('public.about', lang_prefix=None)) }}): what diytracker.ch is and who runs it.
- [Help]({{ canonical_url(url_for('public.help_page', lang_prefix=None)) }}): how to use the site — labels, submitting and claiming events.
- [Venue map]({{ canonical_url(url_for('public.venue_map', lang_prefix=None)) }}): every venue, plotted.
- [Archive]({{ canonical_url(url_for('public.archive_index', lang_prefix=None)) }}): past shows by month.

## Full listings

Individual events and venues change too often for a curated index — see the
full, machine-readable [sitemap]({{ canonical_url(url_for('public.sitemap')) }})
for every event, venue and accessibility page.
